Filter.description: One filter of a runner file: the tasks it accepts, while its window is open.

match.description: `key=value` accepts only tasks with that label; `!key=value` accepts only tasks without it.

when.description: When the filter applies; always when unset. Outside it, the filter is lifted.

MemoryGate.description: `[memory]`: how long a command waits in the memory gate.

give_up_after.description:
How long `priory memory acquire` without `--timeout` waits for its grant before it exits 75
and says to run the command on CI, below 1 hour; it never does when unset.

Platform.description: The machine's operating system and CPU architecture.

arch.description: The CPU architecture, such as `x86_64` or `aarch64`.

Share.description: Shares such as `60%`, above 0 and at most 100%.

cpu.description: The fraction of the machine's CPUs the runner's agents may load together.

memory.description: The fraction of the machine's memory the runner's agents may take together.

Window.description: The days and hours a filter or a lane's cap applies, in `timezone`.

days.description:
The weekdays it applies on; every day when unset. With `hours` that pass midnight, the day
the hours start on.

hours.description: The hours it applies, `HH:MM-HH:MM`, which may pass midnight; the whole day when unset.

timezone.description:
The IANA zone the days and hours are read in, such as `Europe/Paris`; the machine's own
when unset, which a filter allows only in a factory of one runner.

description:
`runners/<tailscale-hostname>.toml` or `.yaml`: a machine that runs agents. Capacity is
measured live, so the file holds the platform and the share its agents may take.

agents.description: The share of the machine its agents may take together; 90% of each when unset.

filters.description: The tasks it claims and starts: only those every filter whose window is open accepts.

upgrade.description: Whether the factory's `[upgrade]` applies to this machine.

title: runner
